setupScript.intro: Creates the user sshsecmonitorer on a VM (choose the system above). It can only log in with the Monitorer's key and only has read-only SFTP access to the agent folder (chroot, no shell, no TTY, no forwarding, optionally only from the Monitorer's IP). Fill in and apply the placeholders here – then just copy or download it and run it on the VM with "sudo bash".
